tips.text: Land Javelin Toss from long range; it hits much harder the farther it flies. It stops at the first enemy it hits, so aim past minions.
After a Javelin Toss hits, switch with Aspect Of The Cougar and jump in. The hit marks the target as Hunted and refreshes the switch cooldown.
Use Pounce on a Hunted enemy to jump from farther away. It also cuts Pounce's cooldown.
Follow Pounce with Takedown on a Hunted enemy who is low on Health. It deals more damage the lower their Health is.
Place Bushwhack in brush and on paths you expect enemies to walk. A trap that hits also marks the enemy as Hunted.
Move through brush to speed up, especially when you are walking toward an enemy champion you can see.
Heal yourself or an ally with Primal Surge when Health is low; it heals more the lower the Health. It also gives bonus Attack Speed.

combos.name: Javelin into Takedown
combos.when: You hit a long-range Javelin Toss and want to dive onto the marked target.
combos.text: A Javelin hit marks the target and resets the form swap, so you can turn cougar at once. Pounce in, then use the empowered Takedown attack.

combos.name: Hunted Pounce
combos.when: You hit a Javelin on a target that is outside normal Pounce range.
combos.text: Pounce has extra range against a Hunted target. Cast it toward them to close a large gap, and it cuts the cooldown.

combos.name: Pounce-Takedown cancel
combos.when: You are chasing a Hunted target and want to burst fast.
combos.text: Takedown can be cast while Pounce is still in the air. Cast it mid-dash so the empowered attack lands as soon as you arrive.

tips.text: Land Javelin Toss from long range on Graves; it hits much harder the farther it flies, and it marks him as Hunted for your follow-up.
Once he is Hunted, switch to Cougar Form and use Pounce to close in, then hit him with Takedown.
Place Bushwhack in brush and on paths he likes to walk. It is invisible, and he can only destroy it with basic attacks.
Don't chase into Smoke Screen. He is slowed there and you can't see outside the cloud.
Fight him when Quickdraw is on cooldown. Without that dash he has a harder time getting away from your Pounce.
Keep Javelin Toss for long range; it hits much harder from far away. Landing it also marks your target as Hunted.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard; Dragon Strike knocks you up along that path.
Do not fight Jarvan inside the Cataclysm arena. Leave with Bushwhack / Pounce, which can cross the terrain, or stay out of range of his ultimate.
Poke Jarvan with Javelin Toss from range and do not trade up close, where he hits hard.
Land Javelin Toss from long range; it hits much harder the farther it flies, and Kayn has no way to block it.
Hit Kayn with Javelin Toss to mark him as Hunted, then switch to cougar form and chase him down.
Place Bushwhack in brush and on paths you expect Kayn to walk, so he takes damage over time and you can see where he is.
Stay out of Kayn's Blade's Reach range; if he hits you, he can follow up with Umbral Trespass from farther away.
Kayn can walk through walls with Shadow Step. Watch for the warning on the terrain edge and keep your javelins ready for when he comes out.
Stay near your minions, allies or a turret when Kha'Zix is around; alone, you take far more damage from Taste Their Fear.
Hit Kha'Zix with Javelin Toss from long range; it hurts most when it flies far, and it marks him as Hunted.
After a Javelin Toss lands, switch to cougar form and jump on him with Pounce, which reaches farther against a Hunted target.
Place Bushwhack on the paths he uses to reach you, since he approaches from brush and stealth.
Press your advantage when his Leap and Void Assault are on cooldown; he has little way to escape or close in.
Land Javelin Toss from long range on Kindred; it hits harder the farther it flies, and Kindred is fragile.
After a Javelin Toss hits, switch to Cougar Form and jump on Kindred while she is Hunted; the follow-up deals big damage.
Don't chase Kindred while Lamb's Respite is active; nobody inside can die, so wait until it ends.
Hit Kindred with Javelin Toss before she can vault away with Dance of Arrows; she has little else to escape with.
Drop Bushwhack traps in jungle paths and near camps to track Kindred and punish her when she walks into them.
Keep your distance and throw Javelin Toss from long range at Lee Sin; it hits hardest when it flies far.
Save Pounce for when Lee Sin uses Sonic Wave or Dragon's Rage on you; jumping away breaks his follow-up.
Lee Sin is weak to magic damage, so poke him with Javelin Toss and avoid trading with basic attacks up close.
Put Bushwhack traps in brush and on paths he takes. Hitting him with one marks him Hunted so you can pounce on him.
Stay away from teammates standing close together in a fight. Dragon's Rage knocks Lee Sin's target into them and knocks them up.

comboRefs.note: A long Javelin Toss hit lets her dive Lee, though Safeguard can shield and dash him away.
Mid-dash Takedown bursts fast, but Lee's Safeguard can escape before the empowered attack lands.

tips.text: Aim Javelin Toss from long range at Master Yi; it hits hardest far away and marks him as Hunted.
Do not count on slowing Master Yi once Highlander is active; Bushwhack won't slow him.
Stay away from him once he has Wuju Style and Double Strike ready, because his basic attacks deal heavy true damage.
Place Bushwhack traps in brush and on paths he takes to your objectives, so you see him coming.
Keep hitting him with Javelin Toss so Meditate costs him mana and time.
Throw Javelin Toss from long range at Naafiri; it hits harder the farther it flies, and she has to dodge it to avoid the Hunt.
Land Javelin Toss first, then Pounce in on the Hunted Naafiri and finish with Takedown for extra damage.
Javelin Toss stops at the first enemy it hits, so a Packmate in front of Naafiri can soak it. Aim for a clear line.
Place Bushwhack traps on paths she will use to flank you. She has no way to see them coming.
Do not fight her once she has used Hounds' Pursuit and killed someone. She can recast it and get a shield.

comboRefs.note: Javelin hit lets Nidalee dive Naafiri, but Naafiri's Call of the Pack untargetability can dodge the follow-up.
Hunted Pounce closes the gap on Naafiri when she stays outside normal Pounce range after the Javelin.

tips.text: Hit Javelin Toss from long range; it deals much more damage the farther it flies. A hit also marks Nocturne as Hunted.
Don't spend Javelin Toss when Nocturne has Shroud of Darkness ready; it blocks the javelin. Bait it out first with something cheap.
Keep your distance from Nocturne when Unspeakable Horror is ready. Break the tether by moving out of range before the fear lands.
Stay near your allies when Paranoia goes off; Nocturne can dash to you, and being alone makes it much worse.
Place Bushwhack in the brush or on paths he uses to reach you, so he takes damage when he walks in.
Poke Shyvana with Javelin Toss from long range; it hits hardest far away, and she has no way to close the gap before her ultimate.
Do not stand and trade in melee. Shyvana grows stronger by attacking, so keep your distance and make her chase you.
When Shyvana turns into a dragon, step away from her fireball and trail, and avoid fighting in a cluster.
Place Bushwhack in the brush and on paths she walks through; it deals damage over time and marks her as Hunted.
Once Javelin Toss hits her, she is Hunted, so switch to cougar form and use Pounce and Takedown to finish her.

comboRefs.note: Hunted Pounce closes a big gap after a Javelin hit, so Shyvana has a harder time staying out of reach.

tips.text: Keep your distance from Skarner and throw Javelin Toss from far away, where it hits hardest.
Stay away from walls when Skarner is charging at you; Ixtal's Impact stuns you if he drags you into one.
Move out of Impale's reach when he is close; he can only hit what is in front of him.
Do not trade blows with Skarner in cougar form for long; his Quaking damage adds up if you stay near him.
Place Bushwhack traps in the brush or paths where Skarner walks to scout and damage him.
Throw Javelin Toss from long range; it hits much harder the farther it flies, and Sylas has few ways to close the gap quickly.
Once a javelin lands and Sylas is Hunted, switch to cougar form and use Pounce to jump onto him.
Stay out of Abduct range, and watch for his Abscond dash. If his chains hit you, you are stunned and he pulls himself onto you.
Do not trade when he is low on health; Kingslayer heals him most then. Finish him fast or back off.
Place Bushwhack in brush and on paths he walks. Sylas can be hurt by a trap he does not see.
Land Javelin Toss from long range on Talon; it hurts most at a distance, and he has little to answer it with when you stay far back.
Drop Bushwhack on the paths Talon uses to roam or flee, so he takes damage over time and you can see where he goes.
Once a javelin has hit Talon and made him Hunted, switch to cougar form and use Pounce to close in, then finish with Takedown.
Stay in human form and keep your distance when Talon is near. He bursts down anyone he can leap onto, and cougar form leaves you close to him.
Use Primal Surge on yourself after a trade to heal back up, especially when you are low on health.
Land Javelin Toss from long range on Viego; it hits much harder the farther it flies. Close up it does far less.
After a Javelin Toss hits, switch to Cougar Form and Pounce onto the Hunted Viego to close in fast.
Set Bushwhack traps in brush and on the paths Viego uses to reach you. He takes damage over time and is revealed as Hunted.
Don't fight next to a fresh kill. If Viego scores a takedown, he can possess the dead champion and come back at you stronger.
Keep your distance when Viego charges Spectral Maw; if it hits you, you are stunned. Dodge it, then punish with Javelin Toss.
Keep Javelin Toss at long range; it hits hardest from far away, so poke Xin Zhao before he closes in.
Place Bushwhack traps on the paths Xin Zhao uses to reach you; they slow nothing, but they deal damage and mark him as Hunted.
Stay away when Xin Zhao has Audacious Charge ready; its range grows on marked targets, so do not let him land Wind Becomes Lightning.
Do not fight beside Xin Zhao at close range once he has Crescent Guard; it knocks you back and he takes no damage from your allies standing far away.

comboRefs.note: Javelin Toss hit lets Pounce close a big gap onto Xin Zhao and cuts its cooldown.
